final_operations_brief:
**Incident Resolution Summary**

A cargo shipment was impacted by a disruption, prompting a review of the manifest configuration context payload string. Following an assessment of alternative routes, the **OPTIMAL_PATH_FOUND** decision was made, selecting **ROUTE-SOUTH-02** with a 72-hour added transit delay. The chosen route utilizes **Port-South** and **WH-SOUTH-303** warehouse, which has a **NORMAL** risk tier and 72% utilization, well below the 85% threshold. The selected warehouse, **Southern Distribution Hub**, is operational and can accommodate the shipment without requiring a **WAREHOUSE_FIT_CHECK** or alternative facility. The resolution ensures timely and secure delivery of the cargo, avoiding **CRITICAL_DELAY** classification.
